en.caption: Silverquill Personality Traits
rows: I'll say whatever I need to in order to maintain my high social status.
I prefer saying the blunt truth over a pretty lie, and I don't particularly care whose feelings I hurt.
I believe that uplifting my peers is the best way to succeed.
I've mastered the art of using humor as a defense, and I always have a charming joke ready.
I always wait before speaking, analyzing the situation for whichever angle is most advantageous to my goals.
No one knows about the all-nighters I've pulled to keep my magic looking effortless, and I'm going to keep it that way.

en.caption: Prismari Personality Traits
rows: I'm the life of the party, and I expect everyone's attention when I walk into a room.
Two weeks ago, I was enthralled with my latest project. Now, I think it's garbage and deserves to be destroyed.
I believe everyone has the ability to express their truest selves through art, and I'm happy to quietly push them in the right direction.
Everyone is a critic, and I work to win them all over.
I'm beset with such an overwhelming sense of ennui regarding my art. Nothing quite captures my attention anymore.
Instead of confronting my negative emotions, I channel them into explosive artistic displays.
en.name: Prismari Personality Traits

en.caption: Quandrix Personality Traits
rows: When I find a subject I'm interested in, I won't stop studying until I know everything about it. It keeps me up at night.
I hope this all makes sense to me one day. Until then, I'm going to keep faking it.
Equations and patterns come naturally to my mind. I wish friendship came just as easily.
I believe I'm always the smartest person in the room. And I'll prove it, even if no one asks me to.
If these classes have taught me anything, it's that reality is a lie, and nothing matters. So why bother?
Before I graduate, I want to achieve something mathematically impossible. I must leave a legacy!
en.name: Quandrix Personality Traits

en.caption: Ship Quirks
rows: A chatty but harmless spirit haunts the cargo hold.
The excessive creaking of the hull echoes throughout the ship.
Any creature that removes itself from the ship's {@item spelljamming helm|AAG} receives a startling but harmless magical shock.
The ship's companionways are smaller than those found in most other similar vessels.
The ship makes a groaning sound in what seems like defiance whenever it comes to a stop.
The floor of the main deck is adorned with a stylized rendering of a mysterious star chart that pulsates occasionally with scintillating colors.
The ship's air envelope has a salty, briny smell.
Bulkheads throughout the ship have lines of poetry scrawled on them.
Unattended tools often go missing, only to reappear {@dice 1d4} hours later in another part of the ship.
A creature seated in the ship's {@item spelljamming helm|AAG} hears faint spacefaring chanteys in its mind except when the ship is under attack.
en.name: Ship Quirks

en.caption: Shipboard Tasks
rows: Scrub pots and dishes in the galley.
Swab the deck or sweep the cargo hold.
Update the ship's navigational charts, which requires cartographer's tools.
Repair the captain's favorite pair of boots, which requires cobbler's tools. (A {@spell mending} spell also does the trick.)
Repair superficial damage to the ship, which requires carpenter's tools or woodcarver's tools. (A {@spell mending} spell also does the trick.)
Compose a new chantey, which requires a musical instrument.
Entertain the crew with tall tales or gossip.
Fix the captain's broken spyglass, which requires jeweler's tools or tinker's tools. (A {@spell mending} spell also does the trick.)
Teach the captain the basics of a language they don't already know.
Prepare a tasty dinner for the captain's table, which requires cook's utensils.
